# Guards: budget, model ceiling and turn cap

This plugin's hooks check every sub-agent launch and tool call. A refusal is a line starting `guard:` that says why and how to fix it.

- **Budget.** The user types `budget $N` (or `budget off`) as a message's first line; a launch that would pass it is refused. Without one, launches stop at $10 a session. To propose one, end your reply with the line `proposed budget $N`; a plain "yes", "go" or "sure" approves it, up to $20 a session in all. Past that, ask the user to type `budget $N`.
- **Model ceiling.** A launch priced above the `ceiling` model in `prices.json` (Opus, as shipped) is refused.
- **Turn cap.** A turn stops at 10 million tokens unless the user types `turn cap 30m` (or `turn cap off`).
- When a guard refuses, stop calling tools; tell the user the spend, what's unfinished and the refusal line, and wait.
- Before a fan-out, say the spend so far, what you'll add and the worst case.
